name: Reverb freeze bridge
description: The current song dissolves into a darkening reverb, and its last moment is frozen into a hanging wash of sound. The next song rises gently out of that wash, thin at first and filling out as the frozen chord lets go. Nothing is time-stretched, so it suits songs that end on a sustained chord, ambient or vocal outros, and pairs whose tempos or keys are far apart.
author: Muisc

freezeBars.doc: How long the frozen wash hangs over the new song

tailBars.doc: How long the wash takes to fade after the freeze lets go

darkHz.label: Darken to
